audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Fiora levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and two items and the page calls it 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10'. Its own whys disagree at nearly every row: whys[1] 'she owns this window unless you Riposte the E', whys[2] 'only trade where there are no tentacles or she wins the exchange', whys[4] 'never fight in the fresh field', whys[5] 'her power peaks while tentacles are up, so disengage'. whys[0] is mixed and whys[3] says 'Even ground here'. The packet reads Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill against a 51.85% win rate.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 4-second leap, so Illaoi is not the immobile target the full layer assumes once tentacles are planted, and Prophet of an Elder God heals her off every tentacle hit on a champion. Test of Spirit comes online at 3 with a 16s cooldown at rank 1 — long enough that Fiora gets windows, short enough that she cannot ignore it. Level 6 belongs to Illaoi because Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit and she is untargetable through the slam.
audit.corrected: Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill in both layers, flipped as one atomic group, with difficulty moved off 4/10 so the rating stops calling a near-even lane favoured.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly ordered and honest: the 1-2 poke window, the 3-5 Test of Spirit danger, the level-6 ult ring, and the 2-item scaling. Added the 120s rank-1 Leap of Faith cooldown so 'bait the ult' has a real duration behind it.
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12s; Harsh Lesson 4s; Tentacle Smash 10/9/8/7/6s; Leap of Faith 120/95/70s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says Illaoi is untargetable during Leap of Faith, so a player who has baited the ult still dumps her combo into it.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags untargetable-dodges-burst for this matchup and the kit carries the untargetable flag on R. Grand Challenge and a chained Lunge spent into the slam are simply wasted — the correct play is to wait it out, which is a different instruction from 'bait it'.
audit.corrected: Stated the untargetability and the 120s cooldown in whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Stand in her W slam'. Harsh Lesson is not a slam — it is a targeted leap onto Fiora that causes nearby tentacles to swing at her, and it is an auto-attack reset on a 4-second cooldown.
audit.why: Kit text: 'Illaoi leaps to her target, dealing physical damage and causing nearby Tentacles to also swing at the target.' _missing/fiora.json separately flags autoreset-burst-tell for this ability. The 4s cooldown is the shortest thing in her kit and the real reason standing near tentacles is fatal, so mislabelling it costs the player the tell.
audit.corrected: Retitled to Harsh Lesson and stated the leap, the 4s auto-reset, and the tentacle swings it triggers.

audit.why: The content layer already gets the most important call right and states it explicitly: parrying Test of Spirit blanks the vessel transfer but returns a SLOW, not a stun, because none of Illaoi's abilities are hard CC. Moved that fact into the full layer's do, where the advice 'Riposte her E' previously carried no explanation at all.
_missing/fiora.json flags needs-antiheal for Prophet of an Elder God, and report[8] already prescribes early Executioner's Calling. No change needed.

edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns a ring of tentacles and she is untargetable through the slam — wait the 120s ult out, never fight in the fresh field.

notes: The content layer is accurate and specific — it names Duelist's Dance, Test of Spirit, Leap of Faith, explains the spirit-damage transfer, and correctly warns that the Riposte return here is a slow rather than a stun. The full layer was boilerplate and its chart plus 4/10 difficulty told the player this is a favoured lane while the content underneath described losing four of seven stages. I moved difficulty to 6/10 and the final rating line to 'Even'; diff is still the enum 'EVEN' and tone still green, which now reads consistently. One gap I could not fit anywhere inside a length band: Illaoi's ultimate is flagged 'grounding' in the kit, which if accurate would shut off Fiora's Lunge entirely during Leap of Faith — Riot's own description does not mention grounding, so per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted nothing. Worth a manual check, because if the flag is right it is the single most important line on this page.
